name: dsh-computer-use
description: Windows Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: the official window2 13-method surface plus a skill-gated Chromium browser catalog. Codex is not required.
modelDescription: Drive Windows desktop apps and Chromium tabs through the DeepSeek Harness Computer Use tools. Use the computer-use skill before controlling the desktop and the computer-use-browser skill before any tab_* work. Never use the Windows key or any shortcut involving it. Do not automate terminals, password managers, security tools, or authentication dialogs. Do not drive the desktop through pwsh, Start-Process, SendKeys, OCR, or screenshot scripts: the get_window_state image is the vision channel.

interface.longDescription: Computer Use lets the agent operate Windows desktop apps and Chromium tabs: it observes windows with screenshots and an accessibility tree, then clicks, types, scrolls, drags and sets values with real input. Apps are gated by an allow list and an approval prompt.
defaultPrompt: Open Notepad and turn these bullets into a clean draft
Build and run the project I already have open in Visual Studio
Test my checkout flow on localhost

serverInstructions: UI automation through the DeepSeek Harness Computer Use tools using the initialized session. Codex is not required.
